paragraphs: Chanamel the Egyptian, high priest in the Second Temple period, made a red heifer: Parah, chapter 3. He preceded Yishmael ben Pabi and lived in Hillel's and R. Yochanan ben Zakkai's days. In his time were Elyoeini ben HaKof, Choni the Circle-Drawer, R. Yehudah ben Tabbai, and Shimon ben Shetach; this requires investigation.
